name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A light motorcycle, motor scooter or bicycle with an attached motor whose seat is at least 26 inches high and whose motor produces no more than five brake horsepower (3,750 W), plus any one-wheeled vehicle with a floorboard or foot rests. It isn't a motor vehicle, so it needs a driver's license but no registration.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle (other than an autocycle), a motor scooter (other than an electric scooter) or a bicycle with an attached motor (other than an electric bicycle), with a seat at least 26 inches high and a motor of 3,700 watts or less or producing five brake horsepower (3,750 W) or less, so five brake horsepower is the cap; pedals are optional

An electric bike that fails the e-bike definition lands here when its seat is at least 26 inches high and its motor produces five brake horsepower (3,750 W) or less; with a lower seat or a bigger motor it is a motorcycle
A pedal-less electric moped with a seat at least 26 inches high is a motor-driven cycle; it isn't an electric scooter, which needs human power and tops out at 20 mph
A one-wheeled vehicle with a floorboard the rider stands on or foot rests, such as an electric unicycle, is a motor-driven cycle whatever its motor

Riders need a valid driver's license but no motorcycle endorsement; the DMV may issue a one-year special permit, with limits such as a top speed, to a rider with a physical disability who can't get a license
Riders and passengers under 21 must wear a motorcycle helmet meeting FMVSS 218 (49 CFR 571.218); the age rose from 18 on October 1, 2025
Riders must wear goggles, glasses or a face shield unless it has a windshield or wind screen meeting DMV specifications
Not a motor vehicle, so it isn't registered with the DMV
Barred from sidewalks, limited-access highways and turnpikes
On a road whose speed limit is above its top speed it must keep to the right-hand lane or a usable right shoulder, except to turn left
Gives an audible signal before passing a pedestrian, cyclist, e-bike or e-scooter rider or another motor-driven cycle
